## Approved Implementation Plan

### Sub-task 1: Make `CostSummary` and `extract_cost_from_log` visible (light)
- Change visibility to `pub(crate)` in `executor.rs` for `CostSummary` (struct + fields) and `extract_cost_from_log`
- File: `acs/src/daemon/executor.rs`

### Sub-task 2A: Extract cost during ghost run recovery (light)
- Read log file via `log_store.read_log()` and call `extract_cost_from_log()` before marking orphaned runs as Killed
- File: `acs/src/daemon/mod.rs`

### Sub-task 2B: Extract cost during graceful shutdown fallback (light)
- Read log file and extract cost instead of copying existing (null) fields
- File: `acs/src/daemon/mod.rs`

### Sub-task 3: Add/update tests (standard)
- Update ghost recovery test to verify cost extraction
- Add test for empty log (cost stays None)
- File: `acs/src/daemon/mod.rs` (test module)

### Dependencies
`1 → [2A, 2B] → 3`

### Note on dispatch loop path
The executor already extracts cost when handling `KillReason::Concurrent` (executor.rs:820-833). If the executor doesn't complete (child process not killed — issue #99), the run falls through to ghost recovery or shutdown fallback, which are addressed by sub-tasks 2A and 2B.
